claims.statement: 目前 /api/chart application path 不使用出生資料資料庫、session store、request cache或background queue，並以Python write guard監看目前同步處理路徑。

control.mechanism: Closed event builder plus sink-side schema validation and non-propagating dedicated logger.

limitations: Future logger or telemetry changes require a new privacy review and canary test.

excludes: reverse proxy, hosting supervisor and third-party telemetry

claims.statement: Application營運事件由封閉欄位與封閉 vocabulary重建，不直接序列化request、response、header或exception。

control.mechanism: Low-level ASGI middleware contains pre-start and post-start Exception paths and isolates event-sink failures.

limitations: Post-response-start failures cannot rewrite an HTTP status already sent on the wire.

applies_to: current FastAPI application wrapped by PrivacyBoundaryMiddleware
excludes: transport failures outside the application boundary

claims.statement: 目前ASGI application boundary以固定錯誤回應與完整response-lifecycle containment避免原始exception進入response或Uvicorn traceback。

control.mechanism: scripts/local/run-local.sh passes an explicit --no-access-log argument and real-launcher canaries inspect process output.

limitations: Startup and shutdown messages remain visible in the local terminal.

applies_to: start.command and scripts/local/run-local.sh canonical local runtime
excludes: future reverse proxy, CDN, WAF and hosting logs

claims.statement: Canonical本機launcher以--no-access-log啟動Uvicorn，避免request line與query進入Uvicorn access output。

control.mechanism: Central lifecycle controller, request generation checks, AbortController, result clear, panic clear and pagehide clear.

calculation_trace.formula: 對每個托勒密相位角(0/60/90/120/180°)的兩個帶號目標，以粗掃描分割根區間後二分求根，僅保留換座邊界前發生者
calculation_trace.note: 求根器在每個取樣點實際查詢星曆，不假設速度為定值，因此對月亮速度變化、被相位行星站留、以及同一視窗內的多重根皆成立。此搜尋仍內含「用哪些星體/哪些相位角」的技法假設，屬方法假設而非純天文事實。定義為現代（Morrison 系）的星座界線＋精確完成，與希臘化 30° 及 Lilly 容許度兩種古典定義不同，見 RES-MTH-SOURCES-2026-08-03 §2

calculation_trace.formula: 若邊界前無任何相位完成（含盤上時刻恰好精確者）-> 空亡；否則以最快完成者為離開星座前的入相位
calculation_trace.title: 月空亡(VOC)最終判定

present_instant_policy.note: 在盤上時刻恰好精確成立的相位既非入相位也非出相位，但它此刻正在完成，故計入空亡判定（月亮不空亡）。它與未來相位分列兩個欄位以便分辨；next_completing_aspect 仍只取最快的未來相位。「此刻」的容差為 1e-09 日（約 0.086 毫秒），實務上極少觸發。
